summary: A household's bag can appear in the depot log before the processing plant takes custody.
realLife: In 2023 testimony on Maine LD 1909, outgoing CLYNK CEO Alison Vanderhoof distinguished the scan at drop-off from the scan confirming that bags had reached Oakland or Biddeford.
gates: An account holder asks about a bag logged at the depot.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: an account holder asks about a bag logged at the depot.

turns.what: Staff locates the bag in processing.
turns.pulledBy: The plant has a matching scan.
turns.writesBack: The inquiry goes to the counting crew.

turns.pulledBy: Only the depot logged the bag.
turns.writesBack: The missing arrival stays on the dispatcher's list.
